facts.business: Eighty Jewellers Limited operates as the master franchisee for Anopchand Tilokchand Jewellers Private Limited, dealing in gold, silver, diamond, and platinum jewellery, luxury watches, and select lifestyle merchandise through a franchise showroom at Shivrinarayan, a flagship retail outlet at Bilaspur, and a branch at Korba in Chhattisgarh.

segments.name: Jewellery, luxury watches and lifestyle merchandise

key_risks: Significant risk of loss of inventory given high value and nature of inventory (gold, diamonds, silver, gemstones) held at various locations including third-party on approval basis
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards. No loans or advances granted to promoters, directors, KMPs, or related parties.
